title: A line priced before the release reads Priced before tiers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'See Financial Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Use a work order on staging, work order 1, with a part line priced before the release and still open.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Point at that part line's sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The details read "Priced before tiers".
  • The price shows no Manual icon.
  • They show the cost and sell price the line recorded.
